name: 2542-longprefill-mixtral8x7b-8gpu
model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1-headdim -- mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 with one key added to config.json, `head_dim: 128` (= hidden_size / num_attention_heads), because this engine era reads that attribute off the HF config and current transformers leaves it None for this checkpoint; weights and tokenizer are the Hub files unchanged, recipe in configs/note.md.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. Not a free parameter: the topology is part of the declaration, and running the same workload at another width would answer a different question.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (MixtralForCausalLM, 32 layers, 8 experts per layer, top-2 routing per token, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, 32768-token window, `sliding_window: null` on this checkpoint's config.json -- full attention, no window). Unquantized bf16: ~93 GB of weights, ~11.6 GB per card at TP=8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams 1, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. One in-flight request is the plainest possible load: it removes queueing, scheduler batching and admission entirely, so what is left is the model's forward path and nothing else.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, FIXED length by construction: every request is exactly 1000 prompt tokens and exactly 50 output tokens (min=max on both). No prefix buckets, no length distribution, no shared prefix -- one shape, repeated, so the run sits at a single operating point. `plain` hands the prompt to the engine as a raw completion string with no chat template and no role wrapper. Per-request sampling is temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0; guidellm's backend forces ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 50 tokens. WIRE LENGTH IS DECLARED LENGTH: the generator encodes a Faker paragraph, truncates to 1000 ids and decodes with `skip_special_tokens=True`; that encode had itself prepended a BOS, so the decoded string carries 999 content tokens and vLLM re-adds a BOS when it tokenizes. The two cancel and the engine's own prompt counter reads exactly 1000 -- measured on this checkpoint's tokenizer, not reasoned.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant on a sparse mixture-of-experts model, one thousand-token prompt and fifty-token reply per request, across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: commit 5d60def02cb5a43fa5864fcb123909b101df9ec5 (`git describe --tags`
# v0.2.7-73-g5d60def02c) -- a commit, not a release.

# MixtralForCausalLM: 32 layers, 8 experts per layer, top-2 routing per token, hidden 4096,
# intermediate 14336, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128. ~93 GB of bf16 weights ->
# ~11.6 GB per GPU at TP8.
#
# LOCAL PATH: the Hub checkpoint byte for byte -- same weight shards, same tokenizer files --
# with `"head_dim": 128` (= hidden 4096 / 32 query heads) written into config.json. This engine
# era reads that attribute off the HF config and today's transformers leaves it None for this
# checkpoint, which kills bring-up; recipe and symptom in configs/note.md.
model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1-headdim

tensor-parallel-size: 8

# The same thing `auto` resolves to for this checkpoint, written out so a change of default
# or a checkpoint revision cannot silently move the activation arithmetic.
dtype: bfloat16

# ~1050 tokens of context are used against this model's 32768-token window. 4096 clears the
# workload several times over and keeps KV allocation off the critical path.
max-model-len: 4096

# This engine's own default, pinned so a change of default cannot move the KV cache size.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# --- DELIBERATELY ABSENT:
#   enforce-eager       -- CUDA graphs stay at the engine's default.
#   enable-prefix-caching  -- not available on this engine, and every synthetic prompt is
#                          distinct, so it would have nothing to hit.
#   max-num-seqs / max-num-batched-tokens -- defaults are far above one in-flight request,
#                          so they do not bind here.
#   chunked prefill     -- does not exist on this engine, so a 1000-token prompt arrives at
#                          the model as one prefill and not as slices.
#   quantization        -- the checkpoint is unquantized bf16 and nothing overrides it.
#   kv-cache-dtype      -- KV is not binding at ~1050 tokens of context and one stream.
